package handler

import (
	"encoding/hex"
	"errors"
	db "example.com/moba-practice/db"
	"github.com/tjbdwanghaibo/roost-core/framework/entity"
)

type IMobaPlayerEntity interface {
	entity.IThreadSafeEntity
	Dao() *db.PlayerDao
}
type IMobaResultEntity interface {
	entity.IThreadSafeEntity
	Dao() *db.MatchResultDao
}

var ErrMOBASettlement = errors.New("moba settlement: invalid result, conflicting identity or economy limit")

// 仅由对局服务器的参考模拟调用，不把客户端自报胜负 / hash 直接转成奖励。
// result 的完整 EntityID 是开局时分配并保留的本场结算身份；同一场重试、恢复必须路由到同一个 ID。
// 成功 / 无胜者终态都保留，双方战绩、奖励与结算身份在同一事务，不用短期请求环充当永久账本。
//
//roost:nest rollback=undo durability=strict
func handlerMOBASettle(result IMobaResultEntity, winner IMobaPlayerEntity, loser IMobaPlayerEntity, matchKey string, digest string, aborted bool) error {
	raw, err := hex.DecodeString(digest)
	if err != nil || len(raw) != 32 || len(matchKey) == 0 || len(matchKey) > 128 || winner.ID() == loser.ID() {
		return ErrMOBASettlement
	}
	d, w, l := result.Dao(), winner.Dao(), loser.Dao()
	status := int64(1)
	if aborted {
		status = 2
	}
	if d.GetStatus() != 0 {
		if d.GetMatchKey() == matchKey && d.GetDigest() == digest && d.GetWinnerID() == winner.ID() && d.GetLoserID() == loser.ID() && d.GetStatus() == status {
			return nil
		}
		return ErrMOBASettlement
	}
	if !aborted {
		if w.GetGold() > 1000000-10 || w.GetWins() >= 1000000 || l.GetLosses() >= 1000000 {
			return ErrMOBASettlement
		}
		w.SetGold(w.GetGold() + 10)
		w.SetWins(w.GetWins() + 1)
		l.SetLosses(l.GetLosses() + 1)
	}
	d.SetMatchKey(matchKey)
	d.SetDigest(digest)
	d.SetWinnerID(winner.ID())
	d.SetLoserID(loser.ID())
	d.SetStatus(status)
	return nil
}
